newsitem.title: JORDAN: Arafat to hold talks with King Hussein in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to hold talks with King Hussein in Jordan.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat will arrive in Amman on Saturday to brief King Hussein on the status of deadlocked peace talks with Israel, a palace official said on Friday.

The one-day talks will also touch on Jordanian-Palestinian ties, which have significantly improved since Amman began adopting a tougher public stance against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Middle East peace policy.
Jordan has lately stepped up its criticism of Israel, accusing it of endangering the kingdom's security by re-activating plans for expanding Jewish settlements in the West Bank.
